boxSubtitle: Drag and drop your periapical radiograph file here
boxHint: Supports PNG, JPG, JPEG, WEBP formats (Max 10MB)
privacyDesc:
Images you upload will be sent to Google Gemini AI for analysis.

Before uploading, you should check the radiograph and remove or cover any information that could identify the patient, such as name, patient ID, or imaging date, if it appears directly on the image.
consentNoTitle: Do not allow image storage for research
consentNoDesc: Do not allow image storage for research.
storageNoticeDesc:
The research image repository has not been implemented yet. Therefore, at the moment, images are not stored in the research repository regardless of which option you choose.

Your choice will be used to determine storage permission when this feature is implemented in the future. In both cases, the image is still sent to Google Gemini for analysis.
